comment: Per-import download budgets in bytes: current sizes + 2 %, rounded up to 500 B. `make e2e` checks the packed tarball against them; raise a limit only for a measured, intended change.

defuss-brotli/compressor/slim.note: VERIFIED (2026-11-09): brotli q11 of compressor.wasm swings between 340,693 and 392,638 B under wasm-opt passes that change raw size by 0.2 % and br4 by 0.2 % (an encoder heuristic), so br11 is budgeted at the upper value.
